page.overview:
What is Mari Mari no Mi?

The Mari Mari no Mi is a non-canon Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that allows the user to create copies of people and command them, turning them into a . It was eaten by Ven Vendler.

The main strength of this fruit is that it allows the user to create copies of people and command them as subordinates. However, the user needs to know a person's name and see them directly in order to create a copy. Notably, because the user has seen themself and knows their own name, they can use the fruit's abilities to clone themselves.

Marionettes created by the Mari Mari no Mi appear to have a fairly low strength ceiling; while they can copy the abilities and Devil Fruit powers of those they recreate, strong figures will be significantly weakened, to the point where a marionette of King was defeated in a single attack from Roronoa Zoro. Once a marionette takes too much damage, it disappears, leaving a limp puppet in its place.

Aside from this, the user is also susceptible to the standard Devil Fruit weaknesses.
